hooks.command: /bin/sh -c '[ -f "$1" ] || { echo "claude hook: launcher not found at $1, so the command was not checked; allowing the tool call" >&2; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"The bash guard hook did not run (the launcher was not found), so the command was not checked; only the deny rules of .claude/settings.json apply.\"}"; exit 0; }; exec /bin/sh "$@"' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/claude-hooks/run.sh" bash-guard

/bin/sh -c '[ -f "$1" ] && [ -f "${1%/*}/$2.ts" ] || { echo "claude hook: launcher or hook script not found under $1, so the command was not checked; allowing the tool call" >&2; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"The merge guard hook did not run (the launcher or the hook script was not found), so merges and deploys were not checked against holds.\"}"; exit 0; }; exec /bin/sh "$@"' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/claude-hooks/run.sh" merge-guard

/bin/sh -c '[ -f "$1" ] || { echo "claude hook: worktree script not found at $1, so the worktree was not created" >&2; exit 1; }; exec bash "$@"' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/worktree-new.sh" --hook
